Settings.title: Platform settings
Settings.subtitle: Operational parameters — sensitive data (keys, email credentials) stays in .env only.

access_token_expire_minutes.label: Session duration (minutes)
access_token_expire_minutes.helper: Time until the access token expires and needs to be renewed.

refresh_token_expire_days.label: Refresh token duration (days)
refresh_token_expire_days.helper: How long the user stays logged in without needing to sign in again.

email_verification_expire_hours.label: Email verification link expiration (hours)
email_verification_expire_hours.helper: Deadline for the user to click the link before needing a new one.

login_rate_limit_per_minute.label: Login attempt limit per minute
login_rate_limit_per_minute.helper: Per IP — protects against brute force.

register_rate_limit_per_minute.label: Registration limit per minute
register_rate_limit_per_minute.helper: Per IP — protects against account-creation abuse.

complete_2fa_rate_limit_per_minute.label: 2FA confirmation limit per minute
complete_2fa_rate_limit_per_minute.helper: Per IP — protects against brute-forcing the authenticator code.

refresh_rate_limit_per_minute.label: Session refresh limit per minute
refresh_rate_limit_per_minute.helper: Per IP — exchanging a refresh token for a new token pair.

resend_verification_rate_limit_per_minut.label: Verification resend limit per minute
resend_verification_rate_limit_per_minut.helper: Per IP — protects against verification email spam.

chat_message_rate_limit_per_minute.label: Chat message limit per minute
chat_message_rate_limit_per_minute.helper: Per user — protects the loan chat against flooding.

password_reset_rate_limit_per_minute.label: Password reset request limit per minute
password_reset_rate_limit_per_minute.helper: Per IP — protects "forgot my password" against abuse.

handoff_confirmation_grace_hours.label: Grace period to force pickup/return confirmation (hours)
handoff_confirmation_grace_hours.helper: After this period since the owner's confirmation, they can force it even without the requester confirming.
